usage: Interactive generative-art pages (vanilla canvas, zero deps). Open in a browser, lift the technique.

generative.title: Curl Noise Field
generative.description: Seeded simplex curl-noise advects hundreds of particles into silk-like trails.

generative.title: Firefly Drift
generative.description: Fireflies wander on noise-steered headings, each pulsing its copper glow on its own clock.

generative.title: Flocking
generative.description: Ninety boids follow separation, alignment, and cohesion — a murmuration on rice paper.

generative.title: Ink in Water
generative.description: Sumo-ink drops bloom and diffuse through water, edges softening as they spread.

generative.title: Magnetic Attraction
generative.description: Particles orbit two attractors and flee one repeller — drag any of them around.

generative.title: Orbit Petals
generative.description: Nested orbital arms at seeded harmonic ratios trace blooming ember petals.

generative.title: Rain Ripples
generative.description: Slanted rain falls, strikes an invisible pond, and spreads fading interference rings.

generative.title: Sand Piles
generative.description: A real Abelian sandpile: grains topple when slopes get steep, avalanches carve the dune.

generative.title: Smoke Letters
generative.description: A seeded word is set in type, then sampled into smoke motes that rise and dissolve.

generative.title: Wind Trails
generative.description: Three layered sine-wind fields carry particles eastward in phosphor-green bands.

generative.title: Circle Packing
generative.description: Seeded tangent circles grow one by one until they kiss, outlined in Bauhaus primaries on black.

generative.title: Harmonograph
generative.description: Damped double-pendulum equations trace fading rosettes in risograph blue and red.

generative.title: Lissajous Weaves
generative.description: Layered Lissajous curves in Bauhaus primaries, weaving trails across off-white.

generative.title: Maze Growth
generative.description: A recursive-backtracker carves a perfect maze live, one cell at a time, in ink hairlines.

generative.title: Penrose-ish Tiling
generative.description: Robinson-triangle substitution grows an aperiodic rhombus tiling in Bauhaus primaries, rotating slowly.

generative.title: Recursive Trees
generative.description: Seeded recursive branching trees that sway in a procedural wind, drawn in ink hairlines.

generative.title: Spirograph Gears
generative.description: Two hypotrochoid gears draw over each other in risograph teal and pink, revealing slowly.

generative.title: Truchet Tiles
generative.description: A field of quarter-arc truchet tiles flips and reseeds live — click the field to reseed.

generative.title: Voronoi Drift
generative.description: Drifting seed points partition the field by nearest-seed on a coarse grid, drawn as ink contour bands.

generative.title: Wave Interference
generative.description: Two radial wave sources interfere live on a pixel field, rendered in Bauhaus primaries on black.

generative.title: Aurora Ribbons (2D)
generative.description: Layered sine ribbons with additive glow drifting over a seeded star field.

generative.title: Blooming Flowers
generative.description: Nine flowers open petal by petal on staggered timers — stems, easing, sway.

generative.title: Cellular Automata
generative.description: Elementary automata growing downward row by row — click to change the rule.

generative.title: Contour Lines
generative.description: Marching-squares contours traced over layered value noise, drifting like a breathing map.

generative.title: Coral Growth
generative.description: Diffusion-limited aggregation: walkers stick on contact, growing branching coral.

generative.title: Jellyfish Drift
generative.description: Pulsing bells with phase-lagged tentacles drifting on slow currents.

generative.title: Reaction-Diffusion Lite
generative.description: Gray-Scott equations blooming into soft coral-like forms.

generative.title: Dithered Shape Portrait
generative.description: A face stippled from 2,400 ink dots by pure code — no image, just a density function.

generative.title: Slime Mold Trails
generative.description: Agent-based slime mold: sniff, steer, deposit, decay — trails with no leader.

generative.title: Topographic Rain
generative.description: Rain streaks fall and each impact ripples the elevation field, warping the topo lines.

generative.title: ASCII Field
generative.description: A flowing vector field rendered entirely in ASCII characters; your cursor stirs the current.

generative.title: Constellation Text
generative.description: The word ORION is rebuilt from star-nodes sampled off its letterforms, linked like a constellation.

generative.title: Gravity Letters
generative.description: Letters rain from above and pile up with simple gravity and collision physics; click to drop more.

generative.title: Kaleidoscope Painter
generative.description: Your pointer paints strokes mirrored twelve ways into a slowly blooming kaleidoscope mandala.

generative.title: Kinetic Type Field
generative.description: Words drift and spin through a swirling force field; your cursor repels them.

generative.title: Dial-Controlled Palettes
generative.description: Three dials live-remix the hue, saturation, and lightness of a whole typographic scene.

generative.title: Pixel-Sorted Gradients
generative.description: Amber gradient bands get pixel-sorted into glitchy streaks, rendered chunky with smoothing off.

generative.title: Ripple Click Pond
generative.description: Click to spawn ripples; floating words bob and tilt on the passing waves.

generative.title: Time-of-Day Sky
generative.description: The sky, sun, moon, and stars are driven by your real local time, with a bubblegum clock readout.

generative.title: Waveform Sequencer
generative.description: A 16-step sequencer drawn as waveforms. Click a column to toggle its step; the playhead sweeps visually.
